newsitem.title: GERMANY: SKW Trostberg likely to adopt IAS in 97.
newsitem.headline: SKW Trostberg likely to adopt IAS in 97.

text.p: German speciality chemicals group SKW Trostberg AG on Wednesday said it plans to adopt International Accounting Standards very soon, possibly already in 1997.

"We are moving towards adopting IAS and will likely use them from 1997. If we don't adopt them next year, then will adopt them in 1998 at the very latest," SKW Trostberg chief financial officer Klaus-Juergen Schulz told a news conference.

In a bid to make their balance sheets more transparent, many German companies have switched to the IAS system with some going one step further and presenting their balance sheet according to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, as used in the United States.
The group is majority owned by VIAG AG.
